## Fixed: TikTok, Instagram, X and other video sites

- **"Error (generic)" on TikTok and other feeds.** On a feed (TikTok's For You, Instagram, X, Facebook, Reddit...) the address bar shows the feed, not the video, and yt-dlp can't download a feed. The download panel and the right-click menu now take the video's own page from the post around the player you clicked.
- **TikTok's video files need the cookies yt-dlp got for them;** NDM's engine now sends them. If a site still turns NDM's engine away, yt-dlp downloads the video itself instead of failing.
- **Any site yt-dlp supports.** An address pasted into Add URL that turns out to be a web page is checked with yt-dlp, so its video is found even on sites NDM doesn't list. More sites are recognized by address (Douyin, Kick, Threads, Pinterest, Tumblr, LinkedIn, 9GAG, Imgur, Weibo, Niconico, Rutube, Odysee, BitChute and others); pictures and documents on them stay ordinary downloads.
- When yt-dlp finds no video at an address, NDM says to open the video's own page instead of showing only yt-dlp's message.

## Browser extension fixes

- The browser's own download bubble came back: it's hidden only while NDM decides on a download, so the downloads the browser keeps show in it as usual.
- A file NDM can't take from the download panel is downloaded by the browser once, instead of being offered to NDM again.
- The download panel shows over videos in full screen.
- After the extension updates itself, pages that were already open say to reload them instead of doing nothing.
